reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Matt from MPH was great from the start, giving advice on the design of the kitchen and recommending affordable but high quality materials etc. He was very aware that we had to live in our home during the renovation… The quality and standard of Matts work is second to none and we couldn’t be happier with the result.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: MPH building services fitted our new kitchen and utility room using Howden’s products. We are very happy with Matt’s work and the end result. Matt listened carefully to our requirements and wishes and fitted our kitchen to a high-quality finish with attention to detail and excellent workmanship…
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Matt had already fitted a new kitchen for me a couple of years ago, so I knew that he was multi-skilled and competent as well as being personable and considerate. He helped me with the design, then subsequently helped me to find the fittings and tiles I preferred within my budget…
items.label: Which? review
